description: Create a custom activity category owned by the authenticated user. The API can generate slug when omitted; if the user already owns the same slug, the API returns an empty 200 OK and does not create a duplicate. Safety: Closed-world: operates within the authenticated user's Tripsy account and accessible trips.

color.description: Hex RGB color without a leading #, such as AABBCC.

data.description: Optional raw custom category fields. Prefer the typed top-level fields when possible; values here are merged first.

icon_name.description: Icon name metadata for this category, such as golf.

name.description: Custom category display name, such as Golf Clubs.

slug.description: Custom activity category slug. When omitted, the API generates one. If the authenticated user already owns this slug, the API returns an empty 200 OK and does not create a duplicate.

name: tripsy_categories_create

outputSchema.description: Standard Tripsy MCP tool response envelope.

data.description: Tripsy API response payload or tool-specific structured data.

status_code.description: HTTP status code returned by the Tripsy API when the tool called the API.

summary.description: Short human-readable summary of the Tripsy operation result.
